profile.org_note: Three operating segments: Canada, U.S. Housing and U.S. Land, with the U.S. reported as West and Central and East. U.S. land is led nationally by Brad Chelton (President, U.S. Land) and U.S. homebuilding by Greg Shaia (President, U.S. Housing); combined land-and-housing regional presidents run Northern California, Southern California (with Arizona), Arizona and DC Metro, while Bill Meyer runs Southeast land and the Kolter partnership (Jim Harvey) supplies Southeast lots. Capital allocation sits with EVP and Chief Investment Officer Warren Krug and the Investment Committee (COO Shane Pearson is a member), supported by a central Investments team under EVP Carl Perrone; CFO Thomas Lui oversees treasury, capital markets and investor relations.
profile.summary: Land developer first, homebuilder second: about 127,000 managed lots (58,931 Brookfield share) at 30 Sept 2026 across 25 North American markets, 2,377 home closings and $1.8B revenue over the last twelve months. Wholly owned by Brookfield Corporation, which funds it alongside unsecured notes; it sells finished lots to other builders, runs land JVs and managed-only land for capital partners, and itself offers land-banking services, so it is as much a competitor or co-investor to a land banker as a customer.
